option_relations.rationale: The option and leaf both describe an acute inferoposterolateral ST-elevation myocardial infarction.
Acute inferoposterior STEMI is a subtype of acute inferoposterolateral STEMI.
Cardiac tamponade due to ventricular wall rupture is not directly related to the provided leaf IDs.
Subacute left ventricular free wall rupture complicating acute myocardial infarction is not directly related to the provided leaf IDs.
